$comment: Ambition sequels: historical-tree events that fire only after a realm has fulfilled one of its ambitions (national-strengths spec 5.4, HER-019). Each trigger holds the leaf {heritage: {who: <tree id>, id: <ambition id>, state: done}}, which the game answers true once that realm has marked that ambition done; ambition ids are realms.<map id>.heritage.ambitions[].id in national-strengths-realms.json, realms are named by their event-tree ids (events-places.json aliases). Same event shape as events-campaign.json; effects use only what the bridge (packages/engine/src/events.ts) lands or the tree keeps: treasury and debt, stability, legitimacy, tech tracks, prestige and the tree's existing modifiers.

amb_casa_de_contratacion.name: The House of Trade at Seville

localization.event.amb_casa_da_india.name: The Casa da Índia
localization.event.amb_casa_da_india.desc: With a foothold on the Malabar coast, the crown opens a house on the Lisbon waterfront that takes in every cargo from the Indies. Pepper is weighed, taxed and sold on from its warehouses.
localization.event.amb_casa_da_india.option.crown_mon: Keep the pepper for the crown
localization.event.amb_gold_of_mina_minted.name: Mina gold at the Lisbon mint
localization.event.amb_gold_of_mina_minted.desc: Each year the caravels from São Jorge da Mina unload gold dust at the Casa da Mina. The court must decide what the new wealth is for.
localization.event.amb_governor_general_of_brazil.des: The captaincies hold the coast, but their lords quarrel and some fail. The crown sends a governor-general with soldiers, priests and settlers to build a capital on the Bay of All Saints.
localization.event.amb_governor_general_of_brazil.opt: Build a royal capital at Bahia
Leave the coast to its lords
localization.event.amb_capitulations_of_granada.name: The terms of Granada
localization.event.amb_capitulations_of_granada.desc: The last Nasrid king hands over the keys of the Alhambra. The terms he signed promise the Muslims of Granada their mosques, their law and their property.
localization.event.amb_cortes_of_toledo.name: The Cortes of Toledo
localization.event.amb_cortes_of_toledo.desc: With the two crowns joined, the monarchs call the Cortes at Toledo. They take back the crown lands and rents handed out in the civil wars and fill the royal council with men trained in law.
localization.event.amb_casa_de_contratacion.name: The House of Trade at Seville
localization.event.amb_casa_de_contratacion.desc: Ships now sail each year to colonies across the ocean. The crown founds a house of trade at Seville to license every voyage, train pilots and register every cargo that comes back.
localization.event.amb_casa_de_contratacion.option.op: Open the trade to other ports
localization.event.amb_bonds_of_the_new_king.name: Bonds of the new king
localization.event.amb_bonds_of_the_new_king.desc: The wars of the roses are over and the new dynasty sits firm. The king's council binds the great lords with heavy bonds of good behaviour, payable to the crown if they stray.
localization.event.amb_court_of_augmentations.name: The Court of Augmentations
localization.event.amb_court_of_augmentations.desc: The crown now heads the church, and the abbeys' lands fall to it. A new court is set up to survey them, collect their rents and decide what to do with them.
Sell the lands to the gentry
Keep the rents for the crown
localization.event.amb_diwani_of_bengal.name: The diwani of Bengal
localization.event.amb_diwani_of_bengal.desc: The Company's traders dominate the Bengal trade. The Mughal emperor offers it the right to collect the land revenue of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa.
localization.event.amb_army_kept_in_peace.name: An army kept in peace
localization.event.amb_army_kept_in_peace.desc: The English hold nothing in France but memories. Instead of sending the paid companies home, the king keeps them under arms in peacetime, paid from a yearly tax.
localization.event.amb_parlement_of_dijon.name: A parlement at Dijon
localization.event.amb_parlement_of_dijon.desc: Dijon is the crown's. The estates of Burgundy ask the king to confirm their old rights; he can win them with a court of their own, or rule them by governors.
localization.event.amb_cyprus_sugar.name: The sugar estates of Cyprus
localization.event.amb_cyprus_sugar.desc: Cyprus is Venetian. Its sugar estates and salt pans pass to the republic, and the senate decides whether to lease them out or garrison the island first.
localization.event.amb_morea_resettled.name: The Morea resettled
localization.event.amb_morea_resettled.desc: The Morea is the republic's, but war has emptied its villages. Venice can count every field and invite settlers, or simply farm out the taxes.
localization.event.amb_morea_resettled.option.census_: Count the land and invite settlers
localization.event.amb_city_repopulated.name: The new capital
localization.event.amb_city_repopulated.desc: Constantinople is the sultan's capital, but its streets are half empty after the siege. He can move families from across the realm into the city, or spend on a palace and covered markets.
localization.event.amb_relics_to_istanbul.name: The relics come to Istanbul
localization.event.amb_relics_to_istanbul.desc: Egypt and the Hejaz are the sultan's. The keys of Mecca and the relics kept in Cairo are sent to his capital, and with them the duty of guarding the pilgrim roads.
localization.event.amb_province_of_buda.name: The province of Buda
localization.event.amb_province_of_buda.desc: Central Hungary is the sultan's. He can rule it directly from Buda with a governor and tax registers, or leave a client king to rule it for him.
localization.event.amb_law_code_of_1497.name: The law code of 1497
localization.event.amb_law_code_of_1497.desc: The Rus lands are gathered under one prince. His clerks write one code of law for all of them: the same courts, the same fees, and one day in the year when peasants may leave their lords.
localization.event.amb_law_code_of_1497.option.one_co: One law for all the lands
localization.event.amb_kremlin_rebuilt.name: The Kremlin rebuilt
localization.event.amb_kremlin_rebuilt.desc: No khan takes tribute from Moscow any longer. The grand prince hires builders from Italy to raise new brick walls and towers around the Kremlin, and new cathedrals inside them.
localization.event.amb_kremlin_rebuilt.option.timber_: Make do with timber and earth
localization.event.amb_moscow_patriarchate.name: A patriarch in Moscow
localization.event.amb_moscow_patriarchate.desc: Constantinople is gone and Moscow's churches stand everywhere. The visiting patriarch of Constantinople is asked to raise the metropolitan of Moscow to patriarch.
localization.event.amb_grain_down_the_vistula.name: Grain down the Vistula
localization.event.amb_grain_down_the_vistula.desc: Danzig is the crown's. Grain from the great estates floats down the Vistula to its quays and on to the west, and Danzig asks to keep its own laws and tolls in return.
Take the tolls for the crown
localization.event.amb_confederation_of_warsaw.name: The Confederation of Warsaw
localization.event.amb_confederation_of_warsaw.desc: One commonwealth now joins the two nations. With the throne empty, the nobles of every faith swear to keep the peace among themselves and never to make war over religion.
localization.event.amb_noon_bell.name: The noon bell
localization.event.amb_noon_bell.desc: Belgrade has held. Across Christendom the church bells ring at noon to remember the victory, and the realm's defenders are praised from every pulpit.
localization.event.amb_black_army.name: The Black Army
localization.event.amb_black_army.desc: The king holds Vienna. His paid soldiers, the Black Army, made the conquest, and they expect to be paid even now there is peace.
localization.event.amb_mahmal_caravan.name: The mahmal sets out
localization.event.amb_mahmal_caravan.desc: The Hejaz is the sultan's and Cyprus pays him tribute. Each year the richly covered litter leads the pilgrim caravan from Cairo to Mecca under his banner.
localization.event.amb_suez_fleet.name: The fleet of Suez
localization.event.amb_suez_fleet.desc: The Malabar trade still runs through the Red Sea despite the newcomers. The sultan builds a war fleet at Suez with timber brought from the north and sends it to India.
localization.event.amb_suez_fleet.option.guard_the_re: Keep it in the Red Sea
localization.event.amb_envoys_from_lisbon.name: Envoys from Lisbon
localization.event.amb_envoys_from_lisbon.desc: The friendship with Portugal bears fruit. Portuguese envoys come up the Gambia to the mansa's court, offering horses and goods for gold and a promise of help.
localization.event.amb_debre_berhan.name: Debre Berhan
localization.event.amb_debre_berhan.desc: Adal is beaten. Where a light was seen in the sky over the field, the emperor founds a church and a new royal town, and holds court there.
localization.event.amb_debre_berhan.option.share_the_: Share the spoils with the lords
localization.event.amb_fasil_ghebbi.name: The castles of Gondar
localization.event.amb_fasil_ghebbi.desc: The roving royal camp gives way to a fixed capital. At Gondar the emperor raises a walled compound of stone castles, churches and baths.
localization.event.amb_fasil_ghebbi.option.keep_movin: Keep the court on the move
localization.event.amb_ordos_wall.name: A wall along the Ordos
localization.event.amb_ordos_wall.desc: Beijing has held and the Oirat war is over. Officials propose a long rammed-earth wall across the Ordos border, manned by soldiers who farm their own land.
localization.event.amb_ordos_wall.option.buy_peace: Buy peace with gifts and markets
localization.event.amb_new_calendar.name: A calendar from the west
localization.event.amb_new_calendar.desc: The new cannon and the learning that came with them have proved themselves. A calendar bureau of Chinese scholars and Jesuit astronomers is asked to reform the calendar too.
localization.event.amb_triumph_at_hampi.name: The triumph at Hampi
localization.event.amb_triumph_at_hampi.desc: Raichur and Mudgal are held. The king returns to his capital in triumph, and foreign merchants and envoys crowd the festival of nine nights.
localization.event.amb_tumebamba.name: Tumebamba, a second Cusco
localization.event.amb_tumebamba.desc: The northern quarter is won. The Sapa Inca builds a new royal city at Tumebamba, with temples, storehouses and a palace to match Cusco's.
localization.event.amb_smiths_to_cusco.name: The smiths go to Cusco
localization.event.amb_smiths_to_cusco.desc: Chan Chan has fallen. Its goldsmiths and weavers are taken to Cusco to work for the Sapa Inca, and the Chimú king's treasure goes with them.
localization.event.amb_baptism_at_mbanza_kongo.name: Baptism at Mbanza Kongo
localization.event.amb_baptism_at_mbanza_kongo.desc: The alliance with Portugal brings priests and masons to the capital. The king and his court are offered baptism, and his son takes a Portuguese name.
localization.event.amb_el_badi.name: The palace of El Badi
localization.event.amb_el_badi.desc: The Portuguese king lies dead on the field and his nobles are prisoners. Their ransoms flow into the treasury, and the new sultan begins a palace of marble at Marrakesh.
localization.event.amb_great_code_issued.name: The great code issued
localization.event.amb_great_code_issued.desc: The government's offices have grown in number and order. After decades of drafting, the great code of the state is printed and sent to every magistrate.
localization.event.amb_hong_duc_code.name: The Hồng Đức code
localization.event.amb_hong_duc_code.desc: The child king has grown into a ruler with a loyal court. His officials draw up a full code of law and a new map of the realm, and examinations open to all.
localization.event.amb_hong_duc_code.option.reward_th: Reward the lords who stood by him
localization.event.amb_madrasa_at_bidar.name: The madrasa at Bidar
localization.event.amb_madrasa_at_bidar.desc: Goa and the Konkan bring their port dues to the sultan. His chief minister builds a great college at Bidar, with a library and teachers brought from Persia.
localization.event.amb_ngazargamu.name: A walled capital at Ngazargamu
localization.event.amb_ngazargamu.desc: The Bulala are beaten and the old lands across the lake are safe. The mai builds a walled capital, ending a century of wandering courts.
localization.event.amb_ngazargamu.option.keep_the_cam: Keep the court on the move
localization.event.amb_laws_of_malacca.name: The laws of Malacca
localization.event.amb_laws_of_malacca.desc: Both shores of the strait answer to Malacca. The sultan's court writes down the laws of the land and a code of the sea, for every captain who drops anchor in the harbour.
